program.name: Core & Cardio Roulette
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Cardio or core in a new shape every day, then a short lift: about thirty-five minutes.
program.about: Cardio and core take turns, never the same way twice. Each day deals HIIT, jumps, sprints, boxing, kickboxing, footwork or a kind of core work, bracing, rotation, hollow holds, Pilates or balance, in a circuit, an EMOM, an AMRAP or a Tabata, then a short lift. The same kind never lands two days running. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
program.split: Every day different · cardio or core, then a lift
